items.label: Open to underside of floor/roof system above - paint all elements (A120 legend); tagged 12'-3 3/8" (two tags across the band)
items.instanceNote: A120 hatches Mech. 025 open-to-structure ("OPEN TO UNDERSIDE OF FLOOR / ROOF SYSTEM ABOVE - PAINT ALL ELEMENTS") with two 12'-3 3/8" tags. A510.2 tags 025 at 9'-3" - the draft's PT-07 line carries that. The two architectural RCPs disagree on whether 025 gets a 9'-3" lid or is open structure painted at 12'-3 3/8" - recorded in no register. Scope flips with the answer (hung gyp vs exposed-element painting incl. joists, ductwork, hangers). Verify renders / RFI before pricing either.
